entries.title: Multi-course admin navigation
entries.content:
BRS can operate as a multi-course system where staff move between course-specific and combined operational views.
An example admin system showed course-aware navigation and reporting. Dashboard and timesheet pages can expose separate course labels, course-specific summary and four-week views, and combined views. Reports can include a Course selector so staff can report on both courses together or an individual course. Course names are club configuration values and should not be treated as product knowledge, but the multi-course pattern is reusable.

entries.title: System Configuration admin variation
entries.content:
Admin access exposes configuration categories and product warnings that are hidden or blocked from read-only roles.
Admin-visible System Configuration can include feature switches and club setup categories such as course-name configuration for multi-course installations and green-fee printer module settings. The page can display product warnings when required configuration is incomplete, such as an SMS sender ID requirement when the SMS module is enabled. Specific enabled settings, club values, and warning state are instance-specific; support guidance should explain what the setting area controls and when staff should contact support for restricted or platform-level changes.

entries.title: Configure Timesheet for multi-course systems
entries.content:
Configure Timesheet manages tee time patterns across years and can support multi-course calendars.
Configure Timesheet exposes year-based setup and can display multiple configured years for editing. In a multi-course setup, the timesheet configuration supports course-aware calendar management. Support answers should describe this as the area used to set tee times and intervals for days, months, years, and course-specific schedules where applicable. Exact dates, intervals, and configured years are club setup values and should not be copied into reusable knowledge.

entries.title: Reservation type online booking control
entries.content:
Reservation Types can control classification, display, and whether partially booked tee times remain available to online booking channels.
Admin help text showed an Allow Online Bookings control on reservation types. This setting determines whether partially booked tee times using that reservation type can continue to accept online bookings through connected online booking channels. Reservation types also affect timesheet display, filtering, reports, and booking workflows. Exact custom types and colours are club-specific; reusable guidance should explain the control and downstream effect.

entries.content:

A configured Facilities module exposes bookable resources with fields for reservation name, guests, room or facility, start and end times, repeat days, and repeat weeks. entries.title: Staff [redacted-name] access profile
entries.content:
A Staff [redacted-name] account can sign into the BRS admin area and view operational pages without being able to access many configuration pages.
Staff [redacted-name] users can view dashboard, timesheet, search, reports, users summary, contacts, facilities, messages, and tools index pages. Configuration pages such as system configuration details, green fee setup, competition setup, timesheet message setup, and text messaging can return a privilege warning. This access level is suitable for gathering template knowledge from visible product structure while reducing the chance of changing club setup.

The dashboard contains tee sheet utilisation widgets with date-range controls such as today, tomorrow, and custom ranges. It summarizes bookings and golfers and separates member and visitor activity. entries.content:

The day view can include sunrise, sunset, and other timing markers and provides a print daily booking sheet link. Observed row contents, names, prices, and booking counts are club state and should not be ingested literally.

entries.content:

Reservation type options can include Member, Visitor, Guest/Member, Competition, Open Competition, Society, Corporate, Team, Reserved, Reserved For Members, Reserved For Visitors, Closed, and club-defined custom types. Booking status options can include Booking Taken, Closed, Confirmed, Deposit Cleared, Deposit Paid Bank, Deposit Received, Deposit Requested, Full Payment Received, Letter Sent, Outstanding Balance, Part Payment, Provisional, and Visitor Request. These labels drive filtering, reporting, row display, and booking workflows. Custom reservation types should be treated as club-specific unless approved separately.

entries.title: Email messaging options
entries.content:
Email messaging lets staff send targeted messages to member and contact audiences.
Email options include Email Membership Types, Email Membership Groups, Email Selected Members, Email the Timesheet, and Email Contacts. Email Membership Types can target members in a membership type and may include male/female options. Email Membership Groups targets members assigned to groups. Email Selected Members lets staff choose from a list. Email the Timesheet targets members or contacts on the timesheet for a date/time. Email Contacts targets visitors, societies, and similar contact database records. Service reminder options include Member [redacted-name] and BRS Registration Reminder. Recently sent message rows are club activity data and should not be used as template knowledge.

entries.navigationPath: Member Booking / Visitor Booking / Tee Time Availability / Open Competitions
entries.content:
BRS exposes separate online booking surfaces for members, visitors, tee time availability, tour operators, and open competitions.
Member Booking is a separate member login surface with username, password, register, forgot username, and forgot password flows. Visitor Booking explains online tee time reservation with instant on-screen and email confirmation and links to book a tee time, cancel an existing booking, and tour operator login. Tee Time Availability month view explains that each cell represents one tee time and provides a legend for free and booked reservation categories. Open Competitions explains online reservation for open competitions and instructs users to select a competition with a Book Now button when competitions exist. Club-specific visitor terms, rates, messages, phone numbers, availability, and competition lists should not be ingested literally.

V12 Retail Finance understand how retail finance can unlock your sales potential, and their innovative, customer [redacted-name] integrates seamlessly and will help transform your business. Working with V12 will give your customers the flexibility to choose the member [redacted-name] want with the option to spread the cost using a range of simple and straightforward finance options. BENEFITS OF MEMBER [redacted-name] GOLFERS APPLY THROUGH THE BRS GOLF MEMBERS WEBSITE AND APP APPLICATION COMPLETED IN A FEW CLICKS CLUB GETS PAID IN FULL THE NEXT DAY NO CLAW BACKS FOR NON-PAYERS PAY FOR MULTIPLE MEMBER [redacted-name] ONE GO TRACK THE WHOLE PROCESS ONLINE ABSOLUTELY NO ADMINISTRATION NEEDED BY THE CLUB SIGN UP NOW FAQs WHAT IS MEMBER [redacted-name]? BRS GOLF have teamed up V12 Retail Finance Limited (V12) to bring to you a new and flexible way for your members to pay for their golf club fees by spreading the cost across a number of payment periods to suit their budget. WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS FOR THE CLUB? BRS GOLF want to help you grow the game of golf, by increasing your member [redacted-name] and offering an alternative option to an upfront payment for golf fees. This will allow the golfer [redacted-name] the cost of their member [redacted-name] may appeal to a different sector of golfer. In addition the club will still get paid the full fees up front. NO INVOLVEMENT IN THE CREDIT APPLICATION. In working with V12 we have developed a fully-integrated solution for the finance application, meaning golfers can self-serve in applying for their member [redacted-name] through their BRS GOLF member login (desktop and/or mobile applications available). This fast, simple and secure application, makes it extremely easy for your golfers to pay for their member [redacted-name] a short on line application process - no more antiquated paper forms to hand write. Importantly, once BRS GOLF have handed the customer [redacted-name] to V12 the club members credit application is handled by V12 and the club member directly. You don't have to get involved in any sale of the finance or the legal obligations that go with it. In fact, the application for finance is so integrated we strongly believe this will increase your member [redacted-name] through this quick and popular form of payment. REDUCED RISK OF LOST FEES. Once V12 have paid you, the member [redacted-name] is between the Golfer and V12. You won't have to worry about any recourse if something goes wrong or if the golfer [redacted-name] their payment to V12. In fact, it's only in exceptional circumstances that V12 may need the clubs help to resolve member [redacted-name]. QUICK SETTLEMENT! The V12 system will provide the golfer with a quick decision within seconds of them completing their details online. Once accepted, the golfer [redacted-name] their credit agreement, the member [redacted-name] is activated immediately and you will receive payment to your bank account within 4 working days from the golfer [redacted-name] agreement. It's as quick as that. HOW DO YOU PROMOTE MEMBER [redacted-name] TO THE GOLFER? BRS GOLF will help you with advertising Member [redacted-name] to all your members (including template emails for you to send, promotional banners within your members' booking website and suggested push notifications for your app users). All financial related terms and facts will be supplied by V12. The only rule, for regulatory reasons, is that you cannot use your own credit advertisement. This benefits you in knowing that any promotion of Member [redacted-name] will be legally compliant. WHAT CAN BE INCLUDED IN THE MEMBER [redacted-name] LOAN? At the moment only the golfers playing fees can be financed this means that green fees, locker fees, buggy hire, or any other playing fees, paid for up front and spread over the term of the golfers member [redacted-name]. In the future we are working with V12 to look at adding other golfer's requirements to the member [redacted-name] so that golfers will have even more affinity with the club. WHAT DOES IT COST? The Golfer [redacted-name] charged a small administration fee on top of their loan. For this product the club won't be charged any subsidy and you will receive the full member [redacted-name]. Member [redacted-name] can be offered on 4 or 10 month terms meaning there are extremely flexible options for you to offer Member [redacted-name] to full year or partial year memberships. HOW DO WE KNOW IF A MEMBER [redacted-name] FINANCE? Through your access to the V12 system, you will have a number of helpful tools to identify which member [redacted-name] successful in their loan application, the loan amount and when this was sent to your bank account. You will also be able to run simple reports which you can download for use in your own accounting system. DO WE HAVE TO BE AUTHORISED BY THE FINANCIAL CONDUCT AUTHORITY (FCA) If you are not authorised in your own right, you can offer the interest free finance loans only, however, the agreement with V12 is that they will consider appointing the club as an Introducer Appointed Representative (IAR). As an IAR you will need to comply with V12’s specific instructions and standards for how member [redacted-name] is promoted to your members. HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO SIGN-UP? You will be required to provide some information to V12 directly via an online form. V12 will need to approve your application and you should be ready to go within 10 working days of V12 receiving correctly completed documentation. Once approved you will be contacted by BRS Golf and V12 with your Member [redacted-name] access rights V12 Retail Finance Limited is registered in England and Wales [redacted-number]. Registered office: 20 Neptune Court, Vanguard Way, Cardiff, CF24 5PJ. Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority, Registration number: [redacted-number]. V12 Retail Finance Limited acts as a credit broker and only offers credit products from Secure Trust Bank PLC trading as V12 Retail Finance. Secure Trust Bank is registered in England and Wales [redacted-number]. Registered office: One Arleston Way, Solihull, B90 4LH. Please select the file and record type which you wish to use, tick Update Existing Members if you want to update existing member records, click 'next' to continue. The file should be in CSV (Comma Separated Value format), which lists each record row by row, with each field separated by a comma. Fields with commas within, should be double quoted, e.g.: [redacted-number],Joe,Bloggs,Full Member,"Requires: club hire, caddy cart" [redacted-number],Sid,Bloggs,Junior Member,No special requirements You need at least the following fields in the appropriate format. Our system will attempt to interpret the data, even if the format isn't exact, but please try to provide the required information where possible. If additional information is provided, we will add this to our database accordingly. WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS FOR THE CLUB? BRS GOLF want to help you grow the game of golf, by increasing your member [redacted-name] and offering an alternative option to an upfront payment for golf fees. This will allow the golfer [redacted-name] the cost of their member [redacted-name] may appeal to a different sector of golfer. In addition the club will still get paid the full fees up front. NO INVOLVEMENT IN THE CREDIT APPLICATION. In working with V12 we have developed a fully-integrated solution for the finance application, meaning golfers can self-serve in applying for their member [redacted-name] through their BRS GOLF member login (desktop and/or mobile applications available). This fast, simple and secure application, makes it extremely easy for your golfers to pay for their member [redacted-name] a short on line application process - no more antiquated paper forms to hand write. Importantly, once BRS GOLF have handed the customer [redacted-name] to V12 the club members credit application is handled by V12 and the club member directly. You don't have to get involved in any sale of the finance or the legal obligations that go with it. In fact, the application for finance is so integrated we strongly believe this will increase your member [redacted-name] through this quick and popular form of payment. REDUCED RISK OF LOST FEES. Once V12 have paid you, the member [redacted-name] is between the Golfer and V12. You won't have to worry about any recourse if something goes wrong or if the golfer [redacted-name] their payment to V12. The V12 system will provide the golfer with a quick decision within seconds of them completing their details online. Once accepted, the golfer [redacted-name] their credit agreement, the member [redacted-name] is activated immediately and you will receive payment to your bank account within 4 working days from the golfer [redacted-name] agreement. BRS GOLF will help you with advertising Member [redacted-name] to all your members (including template emails for you to send, promotional banners within your members' booking website and suggested push notifications for your app users). All financial related terms and facts will be supplied by V12. The only rule, for regulatory reasons, is that you cannot use your own credit advertisement. This benefits you in knowing that any promotion of Member [redacted-name] will be legally compliant. WHAT CAN BE INCLUDED IN THE MEMBER [redacted-name] LOAN? At the moment only the golfers playing fees can be financed this means that green fees, locker fees, buggy hire, or any other playing fees, paid for up front and spread over the term of the golfers member [redacted-name]. In the future we are working with V12 to look at adding other golfer's requirements to the member [redacted-name] so that golfers will have even more affinity with the club. WHAT DOES IT COST? The Golfer [redacted-name] charged a small administration fee on top of their loan. For this product the club won't be charged any subsidy and you will receive the full member [redacted-name]. Member [redacted-name] can be offered on 4 or 10 month terms meaning there are extremely flexible options for you to offer Member [redacted-name] to full year or partial year memberships. As an IAR you will need to comply with V12’s specific instructions and standards for how member [redacted-name] is promoted to your members. HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO SIGN-UP? You will be required to provide some information to V12 directly via an online form. V12 will need to approve your application and you should be ready to go within 10 working days of V12 receiving correctly completed documentation. Once approved you will be contacted by BRS Golf and V12 with your Member [redacted-name] access rights V12 Retail Finance Limited is registered in England and Wales [redacted-number]. entries.content:
Email Messaging | Email Membership Types | Email Membership Groups | Email Selected Members | Email the Timesheet | Email Contacts | Member [redacted-name] | BRS Registration Reminder
AMYS GOLF CLUB Dashboard Timesheet Messages Golf Plus NEW! Facilities Contacts Memberships Users Reports Search Tools Need Help? brs chatbot Sign Out Email Messaging Email Options Email Membership Types Send an email to all members in a membership type. This includes the option to send to Male or Female Members. Email Membership Groups Send an email message to all members in a membership group. Email Selected Members Send an email to members selected from a list of all members. Email the Timesheet Send an email to the members or contacts on the timesheet for a particular date and time. Email Contacts Send an email to Visitors, Societies, etc in your contact database. Service Reminder Emails Member [redacted-name] a pre-defined email message to all members about the BRS Golf Members App. BRS Registration Reminder Send a pre-defined email message to all unregistered members about the BRS Golf Registration Process. entries.title: Demo explored workflow routes
entries.content:
Workflow routes collected from a controlled demo exploration. Review before approving for chatbot use.
Workflow: How do I add a single tee time booking?
Route 1: Admin timesheet booking route
Route 1 actor: Admin or staff user
Route 1 preconditions: User is signed into the demo BRS admin area.; A tee time row is available on the Timesheet day view.
Route 1 step 1: Open the Timesheet day view.
Route 1 step 2: Open a tee time row or existing booking from the Timesheet.
Route 1 step 3: Open the booking surface using https://www.facebook.com/BRSGOLF/.
Route 1 step 4: Use the visible booking controls and service/buggy controls shown on the booking page.
Route 1 step 5: Keep the demo booking as a draft unless commit mode is explicitly enabled.
Route 1 outcome: Booking-linked evidence is collected without submitting a booking.
Route 1 verification: Return to the Timesheet day view and check the booking row evidence.
Route 2: Online member or visitor request route
Route 2 actor: Member or visitor, where club setup allows online buggy booking
Route 2 preconditions: Club configuration permits the member or visitor channel to request buggies online.
Route 2 step 1: Member or visitor requests the buggy during the online booking journey.
Route 2 step 2: Admin verifies the request on the Timesheet booking row or booking details.
Route 2 step 3: Admin adds or confirms any service/charge required for the buggy from the booking details/service area.
Route 2 outcome: The online request appears operationally on the admin timesheet, but charging/service completion remains an admin-controlled check.
Route 2 verification: Check Timesheet booking details and service/charge controls before confirming the customer has been charged.

entries.title: Workflow family: Move a tee sheet booking
entries.content:
Use this family when the user wording is about moving, transferring, or rescheduling a tee sheet booking. Service wording such as buggy, trolley, caddie, or club hire is a variant unless observed evidence proves a separate service-specific route.
Workflow: Move a tee sheet booking
Workflow family: Move a tee sheet booking
Aliases: move a booking; reschedule a booking; transfer a booking; move a visitor booking; move a member booking; move a booking with services attached
Variant 1: Booking with attached service or hire item
Variant 1 applies when: The wording includes a buggy, trolley, caddie, club hire, or another service attached to the booking.
Variant 1 answer impact: Use the same move-booking route unless test-system evidence proves the service has a separate move workflow.
Variant 1 same workflow as: Move a tee sheet booking
Variant 2: Paid booking
Variant 2 applies when: The booking has BRS payment information attached.
Variant 2 answer impact: Use Cut from inside Booking Details so payment information remains attached, then check payment status after moving.
Route 1: Booking Details cut and paste route
Route 1 actor: Admin or staff user
Route 1 preconditions: The booking exists on the tee sheet.; The user can open Booking Details.
Route 1 step 1: Click the tee time to open the Booking Details page.
Route 1 step 2: Click Cut from inside the Booking Details page.
Route 1 step 3: Return to the tee sheet.
Route 1 step 4: Go to the new date if the booking is being moved to a different day.
Route 1 step 5: Tick the checkbox beside the target tee time.
Route 1 step 6: Click Paste.
Route 1 step 7: Check the payment status after moving the booking.
Route 1 outcome: The booking is moved while keeping payment information attached.
Route 1 verification: Check the moved booking on the target tee time.; Check payment status after the move.
Rollback policy: No write action is required to answer from this approved workflow. Future automatic write exploration must create only test records and verify rollback.
Exploration status: starter-approved-local-guidance
aliases: move a booking with services attached

entries.title: Workflow family: Create a tee sheet booking
entries.content:
Use this family for creating a standard tee sheet booking and for variants where the user mentions services attached to the booking.
Workflow: Create a tee sheet booking
Workflow family: Create a tee sheet booking
Aliases: add a booking; create a booking; book a tee time; add a single tee time booking; add services to a booking
Variant 1: Service or hire item attached
Variant 1 applies when: The user mentions a buggy, trolley, caddie, club hire, or another service.
Variant 1 answer impact: Treat the service as a booking-detail variant until automatic exploration proves the exact service route.
Variant 2: Block or repeated booking
Variant 2 applies when: The user asks for multiple tee times or a repeated booking.
Variant 2 answer impact: Do not reuse the single-booking route as the full answer; ask for date, time range, reservation type, and repetition if missing.
Route 1: Single tee time booking route
Route 1 actor: Admin or staff user
Route 1 preconditions: A target tee time is available on the Timesheet.
Route 1 step 1: Tick the box beside the tee time to book.
Route 1 step 2: In the master row, enter reservation name, reservation type, and player names.
Route 1 step 3: Click Add.
Route 1 step 4: Click the booked tee time if more booking information needs to be added.
Route 1 outcome: The tee time is booked on the Timesheet.
Route 1 verification: Check the tee time row after adding the booking.
Write action 1: Create temporary test booking
Write action 1 risk tier: safe-test-record-with-rollback
Write action 1 rollback plan: Delete or cancel the temporary test booking created by the explorer and verify the tee time returns to the original state.
Rollback policy: Automatic write exploration may create a temporary test booking only on the dedicated test system, then delete or cancel it and verify the tee time is clear.
Exploration status: starter-approved-local-guidance

entries.title: Workflow family: Configure the timesheet
entries.content:
Use this family for year/date-range tee time setup, interval changes, and timesheet templates.
Workflow: Configure the timesheet
Workflow family: Configure the timesheet
Aliases: configure tee sheet; set up timesheet; change tee time intervals; add tee times; delete tee times
Variant 1: Settings mutation
Variant 1 applies when: The workflow changes live timesheet setup, intervals, dates, or days.
Variant 1 answer impact: Automatic exploration may read and draft the route, but should not change settings unless a specific rollback helper exists.
Route 1: Configure Timesheet route
Route 1 actor: Admin or staff user with configuration access
Route 1 preconditions: The user has permission for Tools > Configure Timesheet.; Calendar End Year covers the target year when configuring a new year.
Route 1 step 1: Go to Tools > Configure Timesheet.
Route 1 step 2: Use the form at the bottom of the page.
Route 1 step 3: Choose the operation.
Route 1 step 4: Select the year and date range.
Route 1 step 5: Enter the tee time interval or alternating intervals.
Route 1 step 6: Select the tee time range.
Route 1 step 7: Choose sunrise or sunset stopping behaviour if needed.
Route 1 step 8: Select the days of the week.
Route 1 step 9: Click Configure the Timesheet.
Route 1 outcome: The selected timesheet operation is applied to the chosen date range and days.
Route 1 verification: Check the affected dates on the Timesheet after configuration.
Write action 1: Change timesheet configuration
Write action 1 risk tier: auto-restricted
Write action 1 automatic use: blocked
Write action 1 rollback plan: Read original settings, apply only to a test range, restore original settings, and verify affected dates.
Rollback policy: Settings changes are auto-restricted. Automatic exploration can read fields and fill draft forms, but changing settings requires a setting-specific restore-and-verify rollback helper.
Exploration status: starter-approved-local-guidance

entries.title: BRS system ingestion principles
entries.content:
# BRS system ingestion principles

The BRS system crawler is used to learn reusable product behaviour, not to copy a club's private setup.

Approved knowledge includes menu structure, page purpose, setting names, product-authored help text, workflow steps, report names, filters, and relationships between areas such as tee sheet, payments, competitions, memberships, reports, and system configuration.

Do not store member names, visitor names, staff names, email addresses, phone numbers, booking references, payment amounts, green fee values, transaction identifiers, custom club policy text, or exact audit timestamps. When audit metadata is useful, record only that the product exposes last-modified information.

System knowledge must be treated as template knowledge unless it has been reviewed and approved as broadly applicable product guidance.
